import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final long MODULUS = 1000000007;
    static final int MAX_DEPTH = 33;
    static long[] bits = new long[MAX_DEPTH * 2];
    static long n_input, m_input;

    static class Matrix {
        long[][] data = new long[MAX_DEPTH][MAX_DEPTH];

        Matrix multiply(Matrix b) {
            Matrix res = new Matrix();
            for (int i = 0; i <= m_input; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j <= m_input; j++) {
                    res.data[i][j] = 0;
                    for (int k = 0; k <= m_input; k++) {
                        res.data[i][j] = (res.data[i][j] + this.data[i][k] * b.data[k][j]) % MODULUS;
                    }
                }
            }
            return res;
        }
    }

    static int getNumber(Scanner sc) {
        int x = 0, sign = 1;
        char ch = sc.next().charAt(0);
        while (ch < '0' || ch > '9') {
            if (ch == '-') sign = -1;
            ch = sc.next().charAt(0);
        }
        do {
            x = x * 10 + (ch - '0');
            if (sc.hasNext()) ch = sc.next().charAt(0);
            else break;
        } while (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9');
        return x * sign;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n_input = getNumber(sc);
        m_input = getNumber(sc);
        long tempN = n_input;
        int length = -1;
        while (tempN != 0) {
            length++;
            bits[length] = tempN % m_input;
            tempN /= m_input;
        }
        length++;
        Matrix matAns = new Matrix();
        for (int i = 0; i <= m_input; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= m_input; j++) {
                matAns.data[0][i] = 1;
            }
        }

        Matrix[] P = new Matrix[MAX_DEPTH * 2];
        Matrix[] S = new Matrix[MAX_DEPTH * 2];
        Matrix[] A = new Matrix[MAX_DEPTH * 2];

        for (int i = 0; i <= m_input; i++) {
            A[0] = new Matrix();
            for (int j = 0; j <= m_input; j++) {
                A[0].data[j][j] = 1;
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < length; i++) {
            A[i] = new Matrix();
            for (int j = 0; j <= m_input; j++) {
                A[i].data[j][j] = 1;
            }
            if (i == 0) {
                for (int j = 0; j < m_input; j++) {
                    A[i].data[m_input][m_input] = 1;
                    for (int k = 0; k < m_input; k++) {
                        if (k != j) {
                            A[i].data[k][k] = 1;
                            for (int l = 0; l <= m_input; l++) {
                                A[i].data[k][l] = 1;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            } else {
                for (int j = 0; j < m_input; j++) {
                    if (j == 0) {
                        A[i] = S[i - 1][0];
                    } else {
                        A[i] = S[i - 1][j].multiply(P[i - 1][j - 1]);
                    }
                }
            }
            P[i] = new Matrix();
            P[i].data = new long[m_input + 1][m_input + 1];
            P[i] = A[i];
            for (int j = 1; j < m_input; j++) {
                P[i] = P[i].multiply(A[i]);
            }
            S[i] = new Matrix();
            S[i].data = new long[m_input + 1][m_input + 1];
            S[i] = A[i];
        }

        int j = 0;
        for (int i = length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            while (bits[i] > 0) {
                matAns = matAns.multiply(A[i]);
                j++;
                if (j == m_input) j = 0;
                bits[i]--;
            }
        }
        System.out.println(matAns.data[0][(int) m_input]);
        sc.close();
    }
}
